newsitem.title: USA: Group Long Distance sees net loss ahead.
newsitem.headline: Group Long Distance sees net loss ahead.

text.p: Group Long Distance Inc said Friday that it posted a net loss of $1,749,050 for the eight months ended December 31, and that it anticipates that losses may continue through April.

The loss for the eight-month period was the result of higher than expected customer attrition on its recently acquired Adventures in Telcom Inc. As a result, the company reported an additional $1,484,700 amortization expense, it said.
The company also said that it expects to recognize amortization expenses of about $3.9 million in the fiscal year ended April 30 as a result of customer attrition.
Group Long Distance is a long-distance telecommunications provider.
